{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically below true outcomes when sentiment is positive, with the gap increasing as sentiment moves from neutral to strongly bullish",
    "When carbon prices are consolidating (low daily volatility), model forecasts exhibit excessive smoothing that causes them to lag behind true price movements",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative is forecasted too slowly by the model, creating delayed bearish bias",
    "Model mean-reversion level is set too high for volatile periods, causing forecasts to remain above reality when prices are declining",
    "Strong sentiment momentum (changing rapidly) causes model forecasts to overshoot in the opposite direction",
    "When prices have been trending consistently in one direction, model forecasts fail to fully capture the momentum extent",
    "Sentiment analysis incorrectly treats mixed sentiment as neutral when it actually indicates underlying uncertainty and potential reversal" ]}
